verdict.rationale: Teams documents Outgoing Webhooks, which send channel text messages to a registered external web service. That is a genuine outbound HTTP callback, but it covers only one narrow event type rather than a general event-subscription system. Incoming Webhooks and Connectors push content into Teams, so they do not count toward this story. missing for 10: subscription to a broad range of event types (membership, chat, meeting, reaction changes), documented payload/delivery/retry semantics, evidence of a general change-notification mechanism, independent or hands-on corroboration.
